original.target_description: Study 3: ethical versus unethical autobiographical recall; choosing an antiseptic wipe rather than a pencil.

replication.target_description: Experiment 3: Spanish Catholic undergraduates recalling ethical versus unethical deeds; choice of antiseptic wipe versus felt tip pen, Yates chi-square.

n.exclusions: No exclusions reported; table contains all 45 participants.

es.quote: χ2 = .994, n.s.p and φ = .14, see Table 2.

p.quote: χ2 = .994, n.s.p and φ = .14, see Table 2.

notes:
Experiment 3 studies wipe choice, rather than directly measuring guilt; study identifier and requested phi identify the target. Supplied p.5 locator differs from results on article p.160 (PDF p.6 including repository cover). Numerical p is not printed: n.s.p only. Footnote 4 specifies Yates chi-square.
